variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: Module level: reading, selection, camera, and navigation. Follow linked subjects for related levels.

nodes.name: Browser client
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer in each pane

nodes.name: Semantic viewer
nodes.responsibility: Explores one rendered architecture
nodes.description: The read-only semantic-board-canvas module. The board the server holds defines content; the picture is drawn in this page from it, or by the server's render route; local state defines only how a user reads it (ADR 0023).

nodes.name: Fetch semantic reads
nodes.responsibility: Decode the listing, a board, a render and the vault check
nodes.description: Plain fetch to the semantic read routes; refused, unreachable or invalid replies become explicit viewer failures carrying the server's code. There is no write call.

nodes.name: Resolve board meaning
nodes.responsibility: Inspect subjects and variants
nodes.description: Parses the board document, resolves the shown variant, describes nodes, edges, flows, steps, bindings, containment, and proposal standing.

nodes.name: Render stage states
nodes.responsibility: Present every reachable state
nodes.description: The renderedView and stageBody functions in SemanticBoardStage.tsx present loading, waiting, empty, error, stale and drawn states, with the inspector, variant, view and walkthrough controls and the drill trail, from the entry point's query and reading state.

nodes.name: Control camera
nodes.responsibility: Fit, pan, and zoom locally
nodes.description: Computes clamped camera transforms for the server drawing without persisting or inventing board geometry.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.responsibility: Map gestures through the atlas
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.responsibility: Navigate linked board levels
nodes.description: Resolves a link's exact current or named target variant against the target board's document and says its lifecycle before it is opened; a named variant that is gone is reported, never swapped for the current one. The trail back is the entry point's drill navigation (use-drill-down.ts).

nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.responsibility: Focus each narrative beat
nodes.description: Maps beat subjects through the atlas to a focus rectangle and reports named subjects missing from the current view.

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.responsibility: Invalidate live cached drawings
nodes.description: Hears a board's new version from the pane socket and, for the board on screen (or a name it had before a rename), cancels its reads in flight and invalidates its pictures and its document, keeping the last usable picture on screen.

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.responsibility: Mount queries and reading state
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage, mounted by ApplicationPane. It asks the query cache for the picture of the reading on screen, owns the reading hooks (drill trail, level, variant, walkthrough, fit, report) and hands the answer to renderedView.

nodes.name: Picture source
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document and a picture
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn.

nodes.name: Local pictures
nodes.responsibility: Draws a picture in this page from the board and policy the cache holds, and keeps it
nodes.description: Shows a kept picture only when its stamp matches the board's version, the policy and the renderer build; forgets pictures of boards that moved when the server lists them; draws a changed board's readings again ahead of time.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes
nodes.description: Board, resolved variant, view, selection, the drawn version and where a presented walkthrough has got to: what the pane session reports to the server, what an agent and voice read, and what a recording paces itself by.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

beats.heading: Obtain authoritative meaning
beats.body: ApplicationPane mounts SemanticBoardStage. The entry point asks the query cache for the picture of its reading; the page draws it here from the board document and policy the server sent, keeps it stamped with that version, and only a page with no renderer asks the server's render route.

beats.heading: Own only the reading
beats.body: The stage presents explicit states. A new board, variant or view fits the whole reading until somebody pans or zooms, and picking a subject marks it through the atlas; none of it changes board content or geometry.

beats.heading: Explain across levels
beats.body: A walkthrough step is chosen by hand or driven by narration or a recording, and the camera fits its subjects. A drill-down opens exactly the variant it names, and a board's new version reads its picture and document again.

beats.heading: Say what is on screen
beats.body: The pane is told what is on screen whenever it changes: board, resolved variant, view, selection and walkthrough step. The pane session reports it to the server, where agents and voice read it, and a recording page paces itself by it.
